# Third-party notices

The model loader incorporates Monocypher 4.0.3. Its BSD-2-Clause / CC0 dual-license text and upstream notice are preserved in `native/third_party/monocypher/`; the runtime wheel also includes `ring_mac_sdk/licenses/monocypher.md`.

ONNX Runtime (MIT), Bleak (MIT), NumPy (BSD), and PyObjC (MIT) are installed as dependencies with their own license metadata. They are not relicensed by this repository.
